source: 上外版选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 同主题听力(我敬佩的科学家/种子库/筹备科学节/罗莎琳·富兰克林/科学展见闻/好科学家的品质)。long/short 交替，答案可在 transcript 找到依据，与读写关不撞。答案位由 _balance 打散。

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 A Scientist I Admire
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Who is the scientist you admire most, Lily?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: I really admire Zhong Yang, the biologist who collected seeds in Tibet.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Why do you admire him so much?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Because he gave up a comfortable life to protect plants for the future.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That does sound impressive. Was the work difficult?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Very. He often walked thousands of kilometres and sometimes got ill from allergies.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: And yet he never stopped?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: No. He said work that helps others is always worth it.

exercises.translation_cn: A 问 Lily 最敬佩哪位科学家；Lily 敬佩在西藏采集种子的生物学家钟扬；因为他放弃舒适生活去为未来保护植物；工作很艰难，他常走上千公里、有时因过敏生病，却从不停下；他说帮助他人的工作总是值得的。

questions.stem: Which scientist does Lily admire most?
What did Zhong Yang collect?
Why does Lily admire him?
options: He worked to protect plants for the future.

questions.stem: What problem did he face during the work?
options: He could not find any helpers.
He sometimes got ill from allergies.

questions.stem: What did Zhong believe about his work?
options: It was a waste of time.
Helping others made it worth doing.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 What a Seed Bank Does
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A seed bank is a special place that keeps plant seeds safe.
The seeds may be used for medicine or farming many years later.
A seed bank also protects the rich variety of plant life on Earth.
To fill one, scientists must travel far and gather thousands of seeds.
The work is hard, but it is a real gift to people of the future.
exercises.translation_cn: 种子库是一个把植物种子安全保存的特殊场所；这些种子多年后可能用于医药或农业；它还保护地球上丰富的植物多样性；为了装满它，科学家必须远行并采集成千上万颗种子；工作很辛苦，但这是给未来人们的一份真正礼物。

questions.stem: What does a seed bank keep safe?
How might the seeds be used later?
What else does a seed bank protect?
What must scientists do to fill a seed bank?
options: Travel far and gather many seeds.

questions.stem: Who will the seeds help, according to the passage?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Planning the Science Festival
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Our class needs to recommend a scientist for the science festival.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: How about Marie Curie? She won the Nobel Prize twice.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That's a great idea. Why do you like her story?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Because she never gave up, even when science was seen as a man's world.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: True. Should we also include a Chinese scientist?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Yes, let's add Zhong Yang and his work on seeds.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Perfect. I'll prepare the photos and you can write the introductions.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Sounds good. The festival is going to be wonderful.

exercises.translation_cn: A 说班级要为科学节推荐一位科学家；B 建议居里夫人，她两次获诺贝尔奖；因为即便科学曾被视为男人的世界，她也从不放弃；A 提议也加一位中国科学家；B 建议加上钟扬和他的种子工作；A 负责准备照片，B 写介绍；两人都很期待这次科学节。

questions.stem: What are the two students planning?
options: A recommendation for the science festival.

questions.stem: Which scientist does B suggest first?
How many times did that scientist win the Nobel Prize?
Which Chinese scientist do they decide to add?
What will speaker A prepare?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 The Story of Rosalind Franklin
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Rosalind Franklin was a British scientist who studied the structure of DNA.
Using X-ray pictures, she found important clues about its shape.
Sadly, other scientists used her work without asking her first.
She received very little credit at the time because she was a woman.
Yet she never lost heart and kept doing the science she loved.
exercises.translation_cn: 罗莎琳·富兰克林是研究DNA结构的英国科学家；她用X射线照片找到了关于其形状的重要线索；遗憾的是，别的科学家未经她允许就使用了她的成果；当时因为她是女性，她几乎没有得到认可；但她从未灰心，继续做着她热爱的科学。

questions.stem: What did Franklin study?
How did she find clues about its shape?
What happened to her work?
options: It was kept in a museum.

questions.stem: Why did she receive little credit at the time?
How did she respond to the difficulties?
options: She never lost heart and kept working.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 At the Science Fair
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: This science fair is so crowded today!

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: I know. Look at that model of a human body powered by electricity.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Amazing! You can actually see the heart and lungs working.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: The boy who made it says he loves how the body works.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: I wish I could build something like that.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Why don't you bring your model rocket next year?

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Good idea! I feel really inspired after seeing all this.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Me too. Let's join the school science club together.

exercises.translation_cn: A 感叹科学展今天人很多；B 让她看那个用电力驱动的人体模型；A 惊叹能看到心脏和肺在工作；B 说做模型的男孩热爱身体的运作方式；A 希望自己也能做出这样的东西；B 建议明年带上她的火箭模型；A 看完这些深受鼓舞；两人决定一起加入学校科学社团。

questions.stem: Where are the two speakers?
What is the special model powered by?
What can you see working in the model?
What does speaker A plan to bring next year?
What do they decide to do together?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 What Makes a Good Scientist
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: What makes someone a good scientist? It is not only brain power.
Curiosity is just as important, because every discovery starts with a question.
Scientists also need courage to keep going when others doubt them.
Good communication helps them share their ideas with the world.
Above all, they must be patient, since answers often take many years to find.
exercises.translation_cn: 是什么让一个人成为好科学家？不仅仅是头脑聪明；好奇心同样重要，因为每个发现都始于一个问题；科学家还需要勇气，在别人怀疑时坚持下去；良好的沟通帮助他们把想法分享给世界；最重要的是要有耐心，因为答案往往要花很多年才能找到。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what does every discovery start with?
Besides brain power, what is just as important?
Why do scientists need courage?
options: To keep going when others doubt them.

questions.stem: How does good communication help scientists?
options: It helps them share ideas with the world.

questions.stem: Why must scientists be patient?
options: They have nothing else to do.
Answers often take many years to find.
